---
# ======================================================================
# JBR Vitae (jbrquarto 1.0.0)
# ======================================================================
# JBR asks for a short biography of each author, of at most 100 words, in
# an editable format (rendering this file writes vitae.docx), and for a
# passport-type photograph of each author as a separate figure. Write the
# biographies in _title-page.yml, as the "biography" of each author. The
# extension warns when a biography exceeds 100 words.
# ======================================================================

jbr-mode: vitae
metadata-files:
  - _title-page.yml

format:
  jbrquarto-docx: default
---
